svg.title: Universal scalability law
svg.desc: An inventory service grows from 1 to 20 nodes. A dot follows the throughput curve from the page's fit, alpha 0.05 and beta 0.01: it rises to about 4,250 requests a second at 10 nodes, then falls to about 3,480 at 20 while the ideal line keeps climbing. Each new node adds a sync link to every other node, 190 pairs at 20. Sharding removes the chatter and the same 20 nodes reach about 10,000.

g.text: shard: each node owns its slice

svg.text: Throughput peaks at 10 nodes, then chatter between pairs drags it down.
